note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #31, Q4 2024 Public Safety Perception) keeps the 53 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1224.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); its keep list carries bp1_6_1..bp1_6_8, not Q1/Q3's bp1_6_01..bp1_6_99. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q4 data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_08 'Percepcion de seguridad en el cajero automatico localizado en la via publica'; BP1_5_4 'Cambiar sus habitos respecto a permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as) por temor a sufrir algun delito'; BP1_6_1 'Hogar victima de robo total de vehiculo'; BP1_6_7 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de fraude bancario'; BP1_6_8 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de fraude al consumidor'; BP1_9_5 'Percepcion del grado de confianza en la Fuerza Aerea Mexicana'); 53/53 labels agree in content with the Q4 questionnaire sub-item/row carrying the same number, and 132/132 shipped option_text values are character-identical to the catalogos/<item>.csv label for that code. Q4 vs Q3/Q2 (checked against the Q4 print, Q4 dictionary, Q4 catalogos and raw columns, not assumed): question 1.6 is the Q2 household-victimization form ('En los ultimos seis meses, algun integrante de este hogar, incluido(a) usted, sufrio la situacion (CODIGO DE LA INCIDENCIA) de la tarjeta A?', 1=Si/2=No/9), NOT Q1/Q3's news-source checklist -- and Q4 extends it from Q2's 6 incidences to 8: 7 'Alguien uso su chequera, numero de tarjeta o cuenta bancaria sin su permiso para realizar cargos o para extraer dinero de sus cuentas (fraude bancario) o le dio dinero falso', 8 'Entrego dinero por un producto o un servicio que no recibio conforme a lo acordado (fraude al consumidor)'; the interviewer scope note widens accordingly ('PARA LOS CODIGOS DE DELITO 4, 5, 6, 7 Y 8 UNICAMENTE DEBERAS CONSIDERAR A LAS PERSONAS INTEGRANTES DEL HOGAR DE 18 ANOS Y MAS', Q2: '4, 5 Y 6'). 1.5 item 4 carries the Q3 rewording ('permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as)?'), not Q1/Q2's. Everything else in Section I (CP1, 1.1-1.5, 1.7-1.9 stems, sub-items, options, fills) is string-identical to Q3 (batch_683); 1.6 stem and rows 1-6 are string-identical to Q2 (batch_679). Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered Q4 questionnaire wording (not the terser dictionary labels): all 68 distinct Spanish strings shipped are exact substrings of pdftotext -raw output of pp.2-3 after whitespace normalisation (Si/No 1.6 option labels included), and a 160-dpi render of p.2 was read to confirm 1.6 rows 1-8. Structure (batch_675/679/683 convention): CP1 read-aloud intro in instructions; one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2 and 1.4-1.9 the stem is in section_prompt and the sub-item/row in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 are single items with the stem in item_text. Kept as printed: '(LUGAR)', '(CIUDAD)', '(AUTORIDAD)', '(CODIGO DE LA INCIDENCIA)', 'la (al)', 'la (del)', 'la (el)' fills; '(a)'/'(as)' gender fills; trailing '?' and '...'; 1.1 and 1.3 options with their trailing '?'; '[CDMX (3)]' row label on bp1_7_1 only; 'Otro' write-in row (bp1_5_5) as the bare word. Normalised: line wraps joined (1.6 row 7 wraps after 'dinero de'). Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, entry boxes I__I, blank write-in lines, 'ESPECIFIQUE', interviewer directions (CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO; REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'A' Y REGISTRE...; PASA AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON; the 1.7 No-aplica and 1.8/1.9 skip notes; the two 1.6 scope directions quoted above). Tarjeta A is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed; the 1.6 item_text is the row text printed in the questionnaire. Options: only levels present in the live data get rows (no row for 3 'No aplica' / 9 'No sabe / no responde', set missing by the .do); every level each item's respondents used has an option row (53/53). Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2024_q4safety_perception/counts.R, live from the irw_fetch() copy table_context.R cached, no second export): raw Q4 CSV 23451 rows; live 1094446 rows over 23450 ids, 0 duplicate id-item; all 53 live item vectors reproduce the raw file after the .do's recodes -- 265/265 item x level (0-4) counts identical, e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 9625/13762 (9=64), bp1_3 1..4 = 7068/4150/6837/5061 (9=335), bp1_5_4 1/2 = 6858/11156 (3=5423, 9=14), bp1_6_1 1/2 = 537/22901 (9=13), bp1_6_7 1362/22080 (9=9), bp1_6_8 1050/22394 (9=7), bp1_9_1 1..4 = 1174/6445/3984/3228. bp1_8_k/bp1_9_k are blank in the raw file for exactly the respondents with bp1_7_k != 1 (8544/5018/2845/2237/11256/5941; 0 blanks with bp1_7_k==1), per the questionnaire's skip rule. Step 3b: live items match Section I exactly (53 = 1.1, 1.2 x12, 1.3, 1.4 x8, 1.5 x5, 1.6 x8, 1.7-1.9 x6 each). Dictionary defect: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q4 wave (file suffix 1224) -- same as the siblings; Description ('Urban safety perception ratings ... Q4 2024') does not mention that the 8 bp1_6_* items are household crime victimization. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_683 (Q3) for every 1.1-1.5/1.7-1.9 string and from batch_679 (Q2) for the 1.6 stem, rows 1-6 and Si/No; translated fresh only for the two new 1.6 rows, bp1_6_7 ('Someone used your checkbook, card number or bank account without your permission to make charges or to withdraw money from your accounts (bank fraud), or gave you counterfeit money') and bp1_6_8 ('You handed over money for a product or service that you did not receive as agreed (consumer fraud)'). INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions (including the 1.6 notes limiting vehicle thefts to household-owned vehicles and incidents 4-8 to household members aged 18+), and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
